evidence.OBJECT_IDENTITY: The same dark denim jeans, waistband, pockets, seams, and single-pair outline appear throughout.
evidence.ACCESSORY_COLOR: No laces are visible and the gold-toned hardware remains consistent.
evidence.ORIENTATION: The jeans remain front-facing with the waistband at the top and legs extending downward.
evidence.STATE_ORDER: The before frame shows knee fading, the middle shows hands and a tool in contact, and the after frame is more even.
evidence.MIDDLE_NOT_WORSE: The middle frame shows heavier whole-garment mottling and darkening across both legs than the before frame despite local tool contact.
evidence.HANDS: Visible hands have distinct fingers, plausible scale, and no apparent fusion or extra hand.
evidence.SCENE: All frames share the same counter, pink cutting mats, and slat-wall shelving.
